ultimate.description: Battojutsu quick-draw freeze-cinematic — a single guaranteed cursed-energy slash (windup → explosive draw). Costs 100 cursed energy.

getsuga.description: Getsuga Tenshō — a blue crescent energy wave fired from Zangetsu (independent-collision projectile).

chargedSlash.description: Charged Getsuga Slash — a committed advancing blue-energy power slash (Forward).

airGetsuga.description: Aerial Getsuga Dive — a diving aerial slash with a forward glide (airborne).

hollowGetsuga.description: Hollow Getsuga — a Hollowfied horizontal super slash (Down; dark-form burst).

hollowRising.description: Hollow Rising — a Hollowfied rising super launcher (Up; dark-form burst).

ultimate.name: Getsuga Tenshō
ultimate.description: Two-part Zangetsu finisher — a dash-slash rush into a rising crescent uppercut (ultimate_part_1 → part_2), played as one continuous freeze-cinematic; a single guaranteed, range-independent Getsuga that launches the opponent skyward.

chargedDash.description: Charged Dash Attack — hold CHARGE to wind up, release to unleash a forward dashing sword rush (quick tap = short lunge, full hold = long committed rush). Cooldown-gated.

hollowStrike.description: Hollow Mask Strike — a brief Hollow-mask-empowered overhead downward slash (neutral SPECIAL). Heavy committed spike.

yachiruAssist.description: Yachiru Assist (Down+SPECIAL) — Yachiru dashes in and Zaraki hurls her forward as a projectile; VFX on connect. Meter + cooldown gated; usable from Base or Shikai.

ultimate.name: Bankai
ultimate.description: Bankai — a committed red-demon burst: a screen-shaking overhead cleaver onslaught. A one-shot ultimate callable from Base or Shikai; returns to whichever form was active (no mode change).

chargedDash.description: Charged Dash Attack — hold CHARGE to wind up, release to unleash a forward dashing sword rush (quick tap = short lunge, full hold = long committed rush). Cooldown-gated.

hollowStrike.description: Hollow Mask Strike — a brief Hollow-mask-empowered overhead downward slash (neutral SPECIAL). Heavy committed spike.

yachiruAssist.description: Yachiru Assist (Down+SPECIAL) — Yachiru dashes in and Zaraki hurls her forward as a projectile; VFX on connect. Meter + cooldown gated; usable from Base or Shikai.

ultimate.name: Bankai
ultimate.description: Bankai — a committed red-demon burst: a screen-shaking overhead cleaver onslaught. A one-shot ultimate callable from Base or Shikai; returns to whichever form was active (no mode change).

ultimate.name: Serious Series: Serious Punch (Death Punch)
ultimate.description: His single most iconic technique — a freeze-cinematic Death Punch: charge → impact, with a full-screen backdrop treatment on the payoff beat (Stage 5).

incinerationCannon.effect: Incineration Cannon — neutral tap/hold 3-tier charge blast (tap small / hold big / full-charge GIANT column)

machineGunBlows.effect: Machine Gun Blows (Fwd/Air) — rapid yellow jet-punch spread (multi-hit)

ultimate.name: Overdrive
ultimate.description: Overclocks his core into a ~7s overdrive — bigger blasts and faster flurries — then the core OVERHEATS: self-damage + a brief window of extra damage taken.

ultimate.name: Summoning: Twin Serpents
ultimate.description: Summons a colossal serpent that strikes the opponent — a guaranteed, screen-filling nuke.

ultimate.name: Detachment of the Primitive World
ultimate.description: Onoki channels Dust Release to raise a massive stone Golem from the rubble — a persistent summon that fights alongside him with its own moveset.

ultimate.name: Bankai: Konjiki Ashisogi Jizō
ultimate.description: Mayuri releases his Bankai — a towering golden construct assembles from his blade and looms over the battlefield, crushing his foe.

ultimate.name: Three-Headed Wolf
ultimate.description: Kiba and Akamaru fuse into a monstrous three-headed wolf and maul the opponent in a spinning vortex of fangs.

ultimate.name: Bankai: Senbonzakura Kageyoshi
ultimate.description: Byakuya releases his Bankai — a thousand blades scatter into a storm of Senbonzakura petals that converge on his foe.

cherryImpact.effect: Up + Special: committed overhead chakra strike.

byakugouSeal.effect: Back + Special: Byakugou Seal — self-heal (can't start at full HP; interrupted by any hit; 3 uses/round).

katsuyu.effect: Down + Special: Summon Katsuyu — a slug wall that shoves + absorbs (brief i-frames).

ultimate.name: Daichi no Sakebi
ultimate.description: Sakura gathers her full chakra and erupts a storm of cherry petals — a screen-wide blossom burst that engulfs the foe in escalating pulses.

chidori.effect: Special (Raiton): dashing Chidori — advancing lightning-blade strike.

chidoriEisou.effect: Fwd + Special (Raiton): Chidori Eisou — extending lightning-spear thrust (long reach).

raitonSword1.effect: Back + Special (Raiton): Raiton Sword *1 — quick electrified sword swing.

raitonSword2.effect: Up + Special (Raiton): Raiton Sword *2 — advancing electrified thrust.

raitonSword3.effect: Down + Special (Raiton): Raiton Sword *3 — committed electrified beam-thrust.

ultimate.name: Kirin
ultimate.description: Sasuke gathers storm clouds with a Katon Gouryuuka, then guides a bolt of natural lightning down — Kirin, the fastest, undodgeable strike.

gentleFist64.effect: Special: Juukenhou Hakke Rokujuuyon Shou (Eight Trigrams Sixty-Four Palms) — advancing 8-hit Gentle-Fist palm rush that SEALS chakra (drains the foe's meter); green trigram-field FX.

hakkeHasangeki.effect: Fwd + Special: Hakke Hasangeki (Eight Trigrams Mountain Crusher) — advancing double-palm thrust, big knockback + chakra seal.

shugoHakke.effect: Back + Special: Shugo Hakke Rokujuuyonshou (Protective Eight Trigrams Sixty-Four Palms) — spin in place and unleash a RAPID 12-hit chakra-palm barrage (seals chakra), protected by i-frames the whole spin, ending with a knockback palm.

hakkeshoGuuten.effect: Up + Special: Hakkesho Guuten — spin into a rotating chakra sphere that DEFLECTS incoming projectiles + a radial push (i-frames, ghost afterimages).

byakugan.effect: Down + Special: Byakugan — a ~5s buff window: +18% special damage and chakra regen; pulse-ring FX.

ultimate.name: Juuhou Soshiken
ultimate.description: Gentle Step Twin Lion Fists — Hinata shapes her chakra into twin lion-head fists and delivers a guaranteed Gentle-Fist barrage (~198 dmg, seals chakra); i-frames during the cast, blocked hits deal 25%.

sandThrow.effect: Down + Special: Sand Bullet — Gaara flings a compressed sand ball (ground / air / crouch pose). A basic zoning projectile.

sandCoffin.effect: Special: Sabaku Kyuu (Sand Coffin) — sand hands rise under the foe and bind; press Special again in the window for Sabaku Sousou (Sand Burial) damage.

sandTsunami.effect: Fwd + Special: Sand Tsunami — a travelling wave of sand surges forward.

sandDome.effect: Back + Special: Sand Dome — the sand closes into a brief all-direction guard around Gaara (i-frames + radial shove, cooldown).

sandShunshin.effect: Up + Special: Sand Shunshin — a short sand-flicker dodge-teleport (retreat) with i-frames.

ultimate.name: Sabaku Taisou
ultimate.description: Giant Sand Burial — a 砂瀑大葬 kanji cut-in, then Gaara buries the battlefield: sand ripples → giant hands → an engulfing dome collapses on the foe, then he kneels and the ground erupts. Guaranteed ~197 dmg (25% on block). DOWN + Ultimate (full meter) instead SUMMONS Shukaku.

auraBullet.effect: Special: Aura Bullet — Meruem fires a compressed purple aura round (HOLD to charge the heavier variant). ORIGINAL (sheet's non-canon emitter blast).

kingsLunge.effect: Fwd + Special: King's Lunge — a low ant-dash → flip → strike rush (6-Koma X). CANON-ADJACENT.

tailAuraRush.effect: Down + Special: Tail Aura Rush — a low aura-wreathed tail rush. ORIGINAL (sheet's non-canon tail rush).

gungiStance.effect: Back + Special: Gungi Mind Stance — a brief read; a landed hit is answered by the tail lance, an incoming projectile is absorbed into the Aura Synthesis gauge. CANON.

photonField.effect: Up + Special: Photon Field — scatters code-drawn aura photons across the stage (~4s); while active the foe's next special NAME is read on-screen the instant they input it. CANON-ADJACENT.

ultimate.name: Ant King's Onslaught
ultimate.description: Menace-panel cut-in → a 6-Koma X rush → aura-flash barrage → tail finisher. DOWN + Ultimate at full Aura Synthesis instead triggers ROYAL FEAST (heal + Winged Ascension → Rage Blast).

ultimate.name: Kote Barrage
ultimate.description: Boruto unleashes the Kote (Scientific Ninja Tool), firing a rapid barrage of stored jutsu that culminates in a devastating point-blank blast.

ultimate.name: As Planned
ultimate.description: Light writes the final name in the Death Note, sealing his foe's fate (Ultimate). Hold Down+Ultimate for "I Am Kira" — the notebook morphs into the Shinigami scythe.
(Stage 1 placeholder — L has no ultimate; his marquee golden-nova ships as a special.)

ultimate.name: Ryūjin Jakka: End-All Slam
ultimate.description: The Captain-Commander channels the full blaze of Ryūjin Jakka into one overhead strike — a screen-scorching slam that reduces the foe to ash.

almightyPush.effect: Shinra Tensei — global repulsion shove (force-only, blows the foe downrange from any range)

almightyPull.effect: Bansho Ten'in — reels the foe in toward Pain (global gravity pull, no damage)

rinneganDefense.effect: Rinnegan Defense — expanding barrier dome: brief i-frames + nullifies incoming projectiles

ultimate.name: Six Paths of Pain
ultimate.description: Summons the Six Paths — the bodies rush the opponent in a swarm strike (guaranteed multi-hit; blocked → reduced).

ultimate.name: Emperor Time
ultimate.description: Kurapika awakens his scarlet eyes — Emperor Time — gaining full-power access to all his abilities for a limited time. When it ends, the memory-gap leaves him briefly vulnerable.

ultimate.name: Maximum Web
ultimate.description: Spider-Man unloads every web-shooter he has — a full-screen barrage of webbing that engulfs and pins the opponent in a giant web trap.

ultimate.name: Proton Cannon
ultimate.description: The helmet opens and the suit routes full arc-reactor output into an overwhelming repulsor blast — a guaranteed, scaled signature strike.

ultimate.name: Max-Charge Repulsor
ultimate.description: Routes full arc-reactor output into the E* max-charge tier — an overwhelming, screen-scale repulsor beam.

ultimate.name: Super Nova
ultimate.description: Iron Man overloads the arc reactor into a blinding, screen-filling nova blast that devastates everything on screen.

ultimate.name: Killing Stroke
ultimate.description: Deathstroke commits to a full overhead spinning katana finish — a guaranteed, scaled signature strike that ends the exchange.

ultimate.name: Sphere of Annihilation
ultimate.description: Brainiac erupts a field of colossal energy pillars across the arena — a guaranteed, scaled space-denial finisher.

ultimate.name: Will Made Manifest
ultimate.description: Hal pours his full will into the ring, manifesting several massive constructs at once for a devastating combined strike.

heatVision.effect: twin eye beams from the per-frame eye anchor; tap=burst, hold=sweepable beam (laser-heat gauge)

supersonic.effect: supersonic dash + shockwave; passes through projectiles (Mach Ram dive in flight)

sonicClap.effect: thunderclap shockwave: pushes away + destroys weak projectiles

ultimate.name: FLIGHT 37
ultimate.effect: dark-silhouette supersonic grab → carry to the sky → Heat Vision slam

ultimate.name: Rika's Invocation
ultimate.description: Yuta invokes his vengeful curse Rika — she manifests as a persistent ally, advancing on the foe and striking repeatedly for a time.

ultimate.name: Mahoraga
ultimate.description: Invokes the Eight-Handled Sword Divergent Sila Divine General Mahoraga — a shikigami that adapts to any attack used against it, growing stronger the longer it fights.

ultimate.name: Mech Suit
ultimate.description: Batman materializes a giant powered-armor suit for a single devastating strike — it forms, looms, lands one crushing blow, and powers down.

bigBangAttack.effect: Big Bang Attack (neutral) — big slow growing white/blue energy sphere

galickGun.effect: Galick Gun (Fwd) — thin fast PURPLE piercing beam

bansheeBlast.effect: Banshee Blast (Back) — rapid-fire volley of gold ki bolts

spreadFingerBeam.effect: Spread Finger Beam (Down) — fan of yellow bolts, multi-hit

airKiBlast.effect: Air Ki Blast (Up) — one fast rising cyan dart (anti-air)

perfectShot.effect: Perfect Shot (air) — quick precise cyan dart pair

ultimate.name: Kamehameha
ultimate.description: Ultra Instinct flares in an activation charge (Ultimate Action) that flows straight into a full-power Kamehameha — the sheet's largest, most iconic beam.

weaponThrow.effect: Weapon Throw — kunai wrapped in an orange spinning-slash; 3 stance contexts: standing (neutral ground) / crouch (Down) / air (airborne)

ninDogs.effect: Kuchiyose: Nin-Dogs (Fwd+Special) — the 8-dog pack erupts and rushes forward, multi-mauling for a short burst (one-shot, big commitment)

pakkun.effect: Kuchiyose: Pakkun (Back+Special) — summon the pug companion; a lingering multi-hit attacking presence for ~5s

ultimate.name: Raikiri
ultimate.description: Lightning Blade — full charge-hold then a dashing lightning-clad thrust; the Sharingan-empowered variant fires while Mangekyou Sharingan is active.

bodyFlicker.effect: Body Flicker (Fwd+Special) — shunshin teleport-dodge: brief i-frames + a short forward blink (teleport art)

raikiri.effect: Raikiri (neutral Special) — charge-hold the Lightning Blade (hold for more damage, capped) then release to dash + thrust. Sharingan ON tracks the foe; OFF goes straight and can whiff

ninken.effect: Kuchiyose: Ninken — Tsuiga (Down+Special) — hand seals → the dog-pack bursts under the foe and PINS them (rooted + damage ticks) → Bull bite → dismissal smoke. Sharingan ON = longer pin

read.effect: Sharingan Read (Back+Special; needs Sharingan) — a short counter window; if the foe attacks inside it, Kakashi Body Flickers behind them and slashes. Cooldown

genjutsu.effect: Sharingan Genjutsu (Up+Special; needs Sharingan) — a close-range stare that briefly STUNS the foe (tomoe swirl). Cooldown

sharingan.effect: Sharingan (Charge-tap) — toggles the red eye: drains Chakra while active, sharpens Raikiri tracking + gates Read/Genjutsu; at 0 Chakra it shuts off and Kakashi is briefly fatigued

ultimate.name: Full-Charge Raikiri / Copy Ninja / Kamui Rift
ultimate.description: Directional ULT — neutral = Full-Charge Raikiri (~198 EFF guaranteed tracking thrust) · Down = Copy Ninja (mirror the foe's recent projectile; needs Sharingan + copy-ready) · Up = Kamui Rift (spatial-distortion DoT; unlocked by the Mangekyō awakening at ≤25% HP, then EXHAUSTION).

raikiri.effect: Raikiri (neutral Special, ground OR air) — charge-hold the Lightning Blade (hold for more damage, capped) then release to dash + thrust. Sharingan ON (P2) tracks the foe; OFF goes straight and can whiff

kawarimi.effect: Kawarimi (Back+Special) — a substitution guard-escape: swap with a log + smoke and reappear BEHIND the attacker (brief i-frames). Chakra cost + cooldown

kamui.effect: Kamui (Fwd+Special; needs Sharingan, P2) — a long-range spatial rip: the Kamui swirl opens at the foe (grow→twist→collapse) for damage + a brief warp stun

tsuiga.effect: Doton: Tsuiga (Down+Special, P2) — ground crack → the Ninken burst up and PIN the foe (rooted + damage ticks) → smoke

sennen.effect: Sennen Goroshi (Up+Special, P2) — a crouch-lunge poke; light damage, and from behind (cross-up) it launches high

sharingan.effect: Sharingan (Charge-tap, P2) — toggles the red eye: drains Chakra while active, sharpens Raikiri tracking + gates Kamui / Sennen; at 0 Chakra it shuts off and Kakashi is briefly fatigued

ultimate.name: Kamui Raikiri / Obito's Gift
ultimate.description: Neutral ULT (P2) = Kamui Raikiri — a full Raikiri charge, a Kamui swirl opens beside the foe, and the strike comes through it (eye-banner cut-in, guaranteed). Up+Ult (P4) = Obito's Gift — a timed Double-Mangekyō mode (Kamui Intangibility / Warp / Mini Kamui Shuriken), whose own Ultimate (P5) is PERFECT SUSANOO; when the Gift ends the eyes return to Obito and Kamui is disabled for the round.

manaBolt.effect: Mana Bolt — magenta starburst bolt (neutral, ground)

crescentSlash.effect: Crescent Slash — wide disjoint mana arc (Fwd)

blueVortex.effect: Blue Vortex — big slow cyan radial burst (Back, distinct special)

ovalBeam.effect: Oval-Portal Beam — fast piercing magenta capsule (air)

ultimate.name: Mana Blade
ultimate.description: Giant energy blade — charge orb at hand, blade extends through progressive length stages, then a full-length overhead swing (freeze-cinematic; source figure frames 143-148 + beam 125).

rubyCrescents.effect: Ruby Crescents — swings the sword to loose a white energy crescent; HOLD to release two in succession (neutral, tap/hold)

dagonsWrath.effect: Dagon's Wrath — charges forward, sword wreathed in red energy, for a massive explosive burst; crumples on hit (Fwd)

cycloneBreath.effect: Cyclone Breath — inhales and blasts a cone of wind up-forward; tumbles airborne foes, pushes grounded ones back (Up, anti-air)

seismicSlam.effect: Seismic Slam — punches the ground, sending a low shockwave along the floor; catches crouchers (Down, low)

meteorDive.effect: Meteor Dive — dives at a steep angle, sword extended, energy trailing (air)

thrownSword.effect: Thrown Spinning Sword — hurls a spinning energy blade (Back)

chimerianDrone.effect: Chimerian Drone — Charge+Heavy deploys a hover gun-drone that strafes the foe with 3 aimed plasma bolts, then peels off

evasionProtocol.effect: Evasion Protocol — Back+Light: a sidestep with startup i-frames into a quick counter-slash

ultimate.name: Chimerian Onslaught
ultimate.description: Eyes blaze red — converging eye-laser beams blast the foe in a freeze/camera-focus cinematic, invulnerable through the startup. Source: MEGA ATTACK band.

milesWeb.effect: Web-shot — fast thin web projectile (neutral, ranged poke)

milesStrike.effect: Venom Strike — close bio-electric punch + expanding ring-burst (Fwd)

milesArc.effect: Rising Venom-Arc — rising anti-air arc, launcher (Up)

milesStealth.effect: Camouflage — vanish + timed evasion window, phases through hits (Down)

milesBeam.effect: Venom-Beam — big committed bio-electric blast (Back, distinct)

milesDash.effect: Venom Dash — offensive forward gap-closer kick (Charge O button)

ultimate.name: Venom Overload
ultimate.description: Miles builds a full venom charge (the 'Ultimate Action' ready-tell) then unleashes an extended venom-strike combo detonating in an expanding bio-electric ring-burst (Stage-0 items 1-2 — the X+Up sequence; freeze-cinematic, later stage).

swapSasuke.effect: Identity Swap → Sasuke (borrow his kit ~11s; reverts on hit/timeout/KO)

swapDeathstroke.effect: Identity Swap → Deathstroke (borrow his kit ~11s; reverts on hit/timeout/KO)

webShot.effect: fires a fast procedural web-ball projectile from the web-shooters (Up aims a rising arc; airborne fires a falling arc)

webZip.effect: i-frame web-line dive-kick — zips forward through projectiles into a committed flying kick (gap-closer)

spiderSense.effect: spider-sense read — a brief i-frame back-hop evade (free; short cooldown) that slips a strike

webSweep.effect: crouched low web-ball that skims along the floor — beats grounded approaches

ultimate.name: Web Cocoon
ultimate.description: Spider-Man unloads his web-shooters overhead and hurls a giant web-net — on contact it engulfs and pins the opponent in a web cocoon for a guaranteed, scaled finish.

ultimate.name: Dempsey Roll
ultimate.description: Ippo's signature finisher — a rapid side-to-side weaving bob flowing into a continuous flurry of alternating hooks with red motion-arc trails (weave-then-barrage; freeze-cinematic, built at Stage 5).

chakraArm.effect: Neutral+Special (KCM II+): Chakra Arm Strike — an extended golden chakra-arm punch that hurls the oversized chakra fist. [CANON]

dashBarrage.effect: Fwd+Special: Dash Barrage — a KCM-speed dashing punch flurry (4 hits). [CANON-ADJACENT]

flipKick.effect: Back+Special: Rising Flip Kick — an anti-air handstand-flip kick that launches. [ORIGINAL]

gamabunta.effect: Down+Special: Kuchiyose — Gamabunta: seal burst → the toad's dagger slash (sure-hit, half on block). [CANON]

ultimate.name: Tailed Beast Bomb
ultimate.description: KCM III only — Bijuudama: the two Kurama heads flank and a huge dark-chakra sphere erupts forward (camera shake + ultimate zoom). [CANON]

rasengan.effect: Neutral+Special: Rasengan — a spiraling chakra-sphere palm thrust (air = diving Rasengan). [CANON]

rasenshuriken.effect: Fwd+Special: Rasenshuriken — hurls a screaming wind-natured chakra shuriken (ground & air). [CANON]

dotonWall.effect: Back+Special: Doton — Earth-Style Wall — six rising rock pillars that block incoming projectiles while raised. [CANON-ADJACENT]

gamabunta.effect: Down+Special (ground): Kuchiyose: Gamabunta — summon-seal burst → the Toad Boss's sure-hit dagger slash (half on block). [CANON]

throwWeapon.effect: Down+Special (AIR): Throw Weapon — flings a kunai as a ranged air poke. [CANON]

strongDown.effect: Down+Heavy: Strong Down — a red-flame overhead spike. KURAMA BOND 1+ gives it +25% damage & +20% hitbox. [CANON-ADJACENT]

fourTails.effect: Up+Special — KURAMA BOND 2+: 4-TAILS COMBO — transform into the red Nine-Tails beast for a committed 4-hit rampage (claws + chakra-arm slam; the cloak BURNS ~12% of your own HP), then revert to Base. A one-shot COMBO, not a walk-around form. [CANON-ADJACENT]

formLadder.effect: HOLD Charge (P) + tap ULTIMATE — KURAMA BOND 3: transform into the NINE-TAILS CHAKRA CLOAK (the one persistent form). Dramatic chakra-pillar entrance. Tap Charge to exit; auto-reverts on timeout / empty chakra. [CANON]

kcm.effect: NINE-TAILS CHAKRA CLOAK (the Bond-3 form): golden Kurama Chakra Mode — +damage / +speed, golden locomotion, NO guard (pure offense). [CANON]

rasenkyugan.effect: CLOAK Neutral+Special: Rasenkyugan — an extended golden chakra-arm RASENGAN that grinds in → launcher. [CANON]

wakusei.effect: CLOAK Fwd+Special: Wakusei Rasengan (Planetary Rasengan) — a huge slow Rasengan rolls forward. [CANON]

avatarRush.effect: CLOAK Down+Special: Kurama Avatar Rush — the animated gold Six-Paths Kurama avatar SURGES FORWARD in a sweeping 4-beat multi-hit assault (reach grows as it advances; half on block). [ORIGINAL]

rikudou.effect: Fwd+Ultimate — KURAMA BOND 4, once per round: Rikudou (Six Paths) apex — a committed black/gold combo (rod slashes → giant golden fist). Ends in Base & resets the Bond. [CANON-ADJACENT]

kuramaSummon.effect: Down+Ultimate: Summon the GIANT Nine-Tails (Kurama) — the colossal fox rears up and fires a GIGANTIC Tailed Beast Bomb (auto-hit). [CANON]

kuramaAvatar.effect: Up+Ultimate — KURAMA BOND 4: NINE-TAILS AVATAR — summon the giant gold Six-Paths Kurama avatar to loom behind Naruto for ~6s, empowering every strike (×1.4) with an echo flare on each hit, then it fades. [ORIGINAL]

ultimate.name: Bijuudama (Tailed Beast Bomb)

Directional: NEUTRAL = GIGANTIC Bijuudama (Naruto's own gold Six-Paths Kurama heads flank + a colossal dark-chakra sphere; a dedicated air-throw cast pose if fired airborne). DOWN = Summon the GIANT Nine-Tails and fire a gigantic Tailed Beast Bomb. FWD (Bond 4, once/round) = RIKUDOU apex combo. UP (Bond 4) = NINE-TAILS AVATAR summon (see specials). [CANON / ORIGINAL]

backstab.effect: Fwd+Special: Shunshin Backstab — SHARED on all three identities: flicker out and reappear BEHIND the foe with a slash (half on block). [CANON-ADJACENT]

fireball.effect: Neutral+Special: Katon Fireball — a spiraling fire projectile (code-animated fire sheet). [CANON]

kunaiRain.effect: Down+Special: Kunai Rain — a volley of kunai rains down onto the foe's position. [CANON-ADJACENT]

flurry.effect: Up+Special: Body-Flicker Flurry — a shunshin multi-hit slash string with afterimages; closes the gap. [CANON-ADJACENT]

ultimate.name: Susanoo: Shunshin Ranbu

backstab.effect: Fwd+Special: Shunshin Backstab — SHARED on all three identities (half on block). [CANON-ADJACENT]

kunai.effect: Neutral+Special: Kunai Barrage — a tagged-kunai fan (4 kunai spread). [CANON-ADJACENT]

iaido.effect: Down+Special: Iaido Draw — a quick forward draw-slash, a crescent cone in front (half on block). [CANON]

rising.effect: Up+Special: Rising Overhead Slash — an upward launcher (overhead). [CANON-ADJACENT]

feint.effect: Back+Special: Afterimage Feint — streak out, reappear behind the foe with brief i-frames + a light cut. [ORIGINAL]

focus.effect: Charge+Special: Mangekyou Focus — his focus pose + red Mangekyō → a short speed buff (~4s). [CANON-ADJACENT]

ultimate.name: Shunshin: Thousand Cuts
ultimate.description: THE BLADE: body-flicker behind the foe and unleash his committed finisher string — a rapid multi-hit blade flurry capped by a heavy cut. Range-independent sure-hit beats, half on block. Refuses during KO / Brutality / Domain / Rick-Prime-rewind. [CANON-ADJACENT]

backstab.effect: Fwd+Special: Shunshin Backstab — SHARED on all three identities (half on block). [CANON-ADJACENT]

gokakyu.effect: Neutral+Special: Katon — Goukakyuu no Jutsu — a huge rolling fireball (code-animated fire sheet). [CANON]

susanooStance.effect: Down+Special: Susanoo Stance — his GREEN Susanoo ribcage manifests; while in the stance, Special = Needle Volley (two afterimage Susanoo bloom flanking the foe and crossfire green chakra needles) and Fwd+Special = Susanoo Sword (the Susanoo flash-steps behind the foe, leaving an afterimage, then a committed blade slash → green shockwave ring; sure-hit, half on block). [CANON-ADJACENT]

flurry.effect: Up+Special: Body-Flicker Flurry — a shunshin multi-hit slash string with blue/orange X-slash afterimages. [CANON-ADJACENT]

ultimate.name: Kotoamatsukami
ultimate.description: THE PUPPETEER: the ultimate genjutsu. A genjutsu-world backdrop (red sky & sea) washes the screen as three huge Mangekyō eyes bloom; for ~2.5s the opponent's LEFT/RIGHT are mirrored and their Specials & Ultimate are locked — then it lifts cleanly. Deterministic / LAN-safe. Refuses during KO / Brutality / Domain / Rick-Prime-rewind. [CANON]

ultimate.name: Bloodletting / Spring Cleaning
ultimate.description: Directional. NEUTRAL = Bloodletting — a cut-in, a Blinky combo, then a stylized blood-draw that heals Shizuku 40% of the damage dealt (capped at 12% max HP); i-frames during the cast, blocked beats deal 25%. DOWN = Spring Cleaning — a hose-barrage sweep that removes every opponent PROJECTILE on screen (the first 3 go into Blinky's belly) and every opponent-owned cube trap (via the engine's generic lists), while dealing guaranteed sweep damage.

ultimate.name: Thunderbolt Barrage / Godspeed
ultimate.description: NEUTRAL = Thunderbolt Barrage — a long charge into a full lightning blast (big Volts cost; guaranteed beats). DOWN = GODSPEED — full-body electricity: costs Volts on entry then drains steadily, ending with a drained stagger at 0. Toggle two modes with Charge: WHIRLWIND (rush — bolt-dash afterimages, faster strings, crescent Thunderbolt) and SPEED OF LIGHTNING (auto-react — crouch/read + cyan floor line; when the foe crosses it or attacks in range he auto lightning-teleports and counters, max 3).

ultimate.name: Nuclear Burst
ultimate.description: Soldier Boy lets the Compound V off the leash — a three-phase radial nuclear blast that erupts outward, scorching everything in a 360px radius for massive damage.

down.name: Leap Intercept
down.description: One committed forward leap per airtime; 18f landing recovery.

back.name: Covering Unit
back.description: One fragile allied gunner, one shot. 480f cooldown.

ultimate.name: Troobian Crossfire
ultimate.description: Opening blaster must hit unblocked. Two scripted allies fire, then a local explosion. Raw contacts 30+35+35+100; no capture on miss or block.
